title: Callvale before: recordings cross the internet
claim: The bank's data center sends recordings over the public internet, and engineers have no private path to the admin tool.
alt: Before: the bank's data center in New Jersey sends recordings over the public internet to Callvale's production VPC. The transit gateway in the network account has no connection to the bank.
notes: Brief 12 story pair, before; 2-deep.md#decision-record (after Context). Title, claim and alt copied from brief.json; no steps (word budget of the Decision record). Same cells as hybrid-networking-after: bank data center A1:B1, transit gateway A4, web instances A5, admin tool B6, engineers A7. The transit gateway has no edge to the bank, and the engineers have no edge to the admin tool: the absence is the point. Story picture: no AWS rule, no AWS number.
